  --fgThumbBorder: rgba(37, 42, 54, 0.12) !important;
  --fgEpicLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgEpicLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  --fgSteamLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgSteamLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  --fgPrimeLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgPrimeLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  --fgPsnLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgPsnLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  --fgItchLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgItchLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  --fgGenericLogoWidth: 28px !important;
  --fgGenericLogoHeight: 28px !important;
  font-family:
    'Roboto',
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    Segoe UI,
    Arial,
    sans-serif !important;
  color: var(--fgPageInk) !important;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .freegameswidget {
    --fgTitleInk: #ffffff !important;
    --fgPageInk: #ffffff !important;
    --fgMutedInk: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) !important;
    --fgCardSurface: #252525 !important;
    --fgPillSurface: #4d4d4d !important;
    --fgCardOutline: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
    --fgThumbBorder: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
  }
}

.freegameswidget__filter {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  clip-path: inset(50%) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
}

.freegameswidget__tabs {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  padding-bottom: 8px !important;
}

.freegameswidget__pill {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  height: 34px !important;
  padding: 0 12px !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  background: var(--fgPillSurface) !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  color: var(--fgTitleInk) !important;
  font-family:
    'Khand',
    'Roboto',
    system-ui,
    -apple-system,
    Segoe UI,
    Arial,
    sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1rem !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  user-select: none !important;
  transition:
    background 0.12s ease,

}

  border-radius: 14px !important;

  gap: 12px !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;

                            }

                    },
                    (['live', 'production', 'prod'].includes(environment)) ? 'live' : environment, // TODO: Fix AdsNinja environment.

<p>The <strong>Epic Games Store's next free games</strong> are pretty big titles, although they have been out for more than half a decade by this point. <strong><em>Breathedge</em></strong> is a <a href="https://gamerant.com/open-world-rpgs-survival-live-off-land/" target="_blank">survival open-world game</a> set in space, and it doesn't take itself too seriously. The sequel is set to enter early access on August 31, 2026, so this giveaway is a good opportunity to jump into the original and see if this is something you might want to follow long-term. Although far from flawless, the original is a solid first-person exploration game that has a unique tone.</p>

    </div>
</section><p>The other freebie is <em><strong>Rival Stars Horse Racing</strong></em>, a fairly old game with a mostly positive reputation. As suggested by its title, the campaign focuses on horse racing, offering both single-player and online. You can even design your own horse through a creator. Horse racing is far from the only thing you do in the game, as you also breed horses and get to explore some gorgeous locations.</p>

<p>Roughly a decade old by this point, <strong><em>Alone With You</em></strong> is the new <strong>free Epic Games Store game</strong>​​​​​​, and it's perfect for anybody craving a "<a href="https://gamerant.com/best-planetary-romance-games/" target="_blank">sci-fi romance adventure</a>." A failed terraforming colony leaves you as the only survivor, and you have a couple of weeks to repair an escape pod before the planet collapses. While that might suggest a survival game, <em>Alone With You</em> is primarily a visual novel with adventure elements.</p>    

<section class="emaki-custom-block emaki-custom-pullquote" data-nosnippet="">
    <div class="emaki-custom pullquote" id="custom_block_21">

        
            <div class="custom_block-content pullquote"><p>A bittersweet sci-fi adventure game that goes right for the heart.</p>    </div>
    
        
    </div>
</section><p>During the day, you explore research facilities and ruins, as well as complete some puzzles in the hope of scavenging parts. At night, you interact with AI holograms of the deceased colonists to learn more from them, specifically to aid your escape attempt but also to not feel so alone. Different choices impact the plot progression, so <em>Alone With You</em> is quite replayable, even if a single playthrough might not last that long.</p>

            <script>
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
                const root = document.querySelector('[data-guid="1005858367footerNewsletter"]');
                if (!root) return;
                const sentinelCategory = 'Newsletter Footer Widget';

                function handleResponse(color = "green", message = "") {
                    const el = root.querySelector('[data-newsletter-response]');
                    if (!el) return;

                    el.style.setProperty('color', color, 'important');
                    el.innerText = message;
                    if (message) {
                        el.classList.remove('is-hidden');
                    }

                    const input = root.querySelector('input[name="email"]');
                    if (input && message && color === 'red') {
                        input.classList.add('error');
                    }
                }

                function clearResponse() {
                    const el = root.querySelector('[data-newsletter-response]');
                    if (el) {
                        el.classList.add('is-hidden');
                        el.innerText = '';
                    }

                    const input = root.querySelector('input[name="email"]');
                    if (input) {
                        input.classList.remove('error');
                    }
                }

                function parseNewsletterResponse(response) {
                    return response.text().then(function(text) {
                        let data = null;
                        if (text) {
                            try {
                                data = JSON.parse(text);
                            } catch (err) {
                                data = null;
                            }
                        }

                        if (!response.ok) {
                            const message = data && data.message ? data.message : (text || `Newsletter subscription failed (${response.status})`);
                            throw new Error(message);
                        }

                        if (!data) {
                            throw new Error('Newsletter subscription failed. Please try again.');
                        }

                        return data;
                    });
                }

                function showRegisterForm(email) {
                    let loginCompleted = false;
                    let valnetLogin = new ValnetLogin({
                        mode : 'popup',
                        idParent: null,
                        className: 'popup',
                        triggeredFrom: 'newsletter',
                        gaEventCategory: sentinelCategory,
                        showCloseButton: true,
                        email: email,
                        isUserExists : false,
                        onFinishedSignOnProcess: function () {
                            loginCompleted = true;
                        },
                        onClosePopupCallback: function () {
                            if (!loginCompleted && window.websiteSentinel) {
                                window.websiteSentinel.sendEvent(sentinelCategory, "dismissed_login", "");
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    valnetLogin.showLoginForm(valnetLogin);
                }

                function subscribe() {
                    clearResponse();

                    const emailInput = root.querySelector('input[name="email"]');
                    const mailingListCheckboxes = root.querySelectorAll('.cta-mailingList:checked');
                    const mailingListIds = Array.from(mailingListCheckboxes).map(cb => cb.value);

                    const formData = new FormData();
                    formData.append('email', emailInput.value);
                    mailingListIds.forEach(id => formData.append('mailingList[]', id));

                    return fetch("/page/newsletter/subscribe/", {
                        method: "POST",
                        body: formData,
                        credentials: "same-origin"
                    })
                    .then(parseNewsletterResponse)
                    .then(response => {
                        if (response.success) {
                            handleResponse('green', response.message);
                            const firstMailingListId = mailingListIds.length > 0 ? mailingListIds[0] : 'unknown';
                            if (window.websiteSentinel) window.websiteSentinel.sendEvent(sentinelCategory, "newsletter_subscription", firstMailingListId);
                            if (response.email && !response.isUserExists) showRegisterForm(response.email);
                        } else {
                            handleResponse('red', response.message);
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(err => {
                        handleResponse('red', err.message);
                    });
                }

                let captchaManager = null;

                function initCaptcha() {
                    if (typeof window.CaptchaManager === 'undefined') {
                        setTimeout(initCaptcha, 100);
                        return;
                    }

                    captchaManager = new window.CaptchaManager({
                        v3Config: {
                            siteKey: window.v3RecaptchaSiteKey,
                            action: 'newsletter'
                        },
                        v2Config: {
                            siteKey: window.recaptchaSiteKey,
                            containerId: 'v2-captcha-container-1005858367footerNewsletter',
                        },
                        autoSubmit: true,
                        submitCallback: subscribe,
                        handleResponse: handleResponse
                    });
                }

                const submitBtn = root.querySelector('[name="SubmitButton"]');
                if (submitBtn) {
                    initCaptcha();

                    submitBtn.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
                        ev.preventDefault();
                        clearResponse();

                        const emailInput = root.querySelector('input[name="email"]');
                        if (!emailInput || !emailInput.value) {
                            handleResponse("red", "Email is required");
                            return;
                        }

                        if (!emailInput.checkValidity()) {
                            handleResponse("red", "Please enter a valid email address");
                            return;
                        }

                        if (captchaManager) {
                            captchaManager.verifyAndSubmit();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        </script>

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            var queryString = window.location.search || '';
            var keyValPairs = [];
            var params      = {};

            queryString     = queryString.substr(1);
            if (queryString.length)
            {
                keyValPairs = queryString.split('&');
                for (var i = 0; i < keyValPairs.length; i++)
                {
                    var key = keyValPairs[i].split('=')[0];
                    if (!key.length) continue;
                    if (typeof params[key] === 'undefined')
                        params[key] = [];
                    params[key].push(keyValPairs[i].split('=')[1]);
                }

                if (params['view'] !== undefined) {
                    if (params['view'] == "list" || params['view'] == "lista") {
                        valnet_cookie.set("view",params['view']);
                    }
                }

                var campaign = null;
                if (params['utm_source'] !== undefined) {
                    campaign = params['utm_source'];
                }
                if (campaign !== null) {
                    valnet_cookie.set("campaign",campaign);
                }
            }
        });
    </script>

        /** For Read More button on LP **/
        window.toggleReadmoreButton=()=>{
            let e=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc');
            for(let t=0;t<e.length;t++)e[t].classList.add('js-show-full');
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let e=0;e<n.length;e++)n[e].classList.contains('js-show-btn')&&n[e].remove();
        }
        window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons=()=>{
            let n=document.getElementsByClassName('listing-desc-btn');
            for(let t=0;t<n.length;t++){
                let e=n[t],i=e.previousElementSibling;
                if(!i||i.nodeType!==1||!i.classList.contains('listing-desc'))continue;
                if(i.classList.contains('js-show-full')){e.classList.remove('js-show-btn');continue}
                i.scrollHeight-i.clientHeight>1?e.classList.add('js-show-btn'):e.classList.remove('js-show-btn')
            }
        };
        let listingReadmoreResizeTimer;
        const runListingReadmoreUpdate=()=>{window.updateListingDescReadmoreButtons()};
        if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',runListingReadmoreUpdate)}else{runListingReadmoreUpdate()}
        window.addEventListener('load',runListingReadmoreUpdate);
        window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(listingReadmoreResizeTimer);listingReadmoreResizeTimer=setTimeout(runListingReadmoreUpdate,100)});
    </script>

  function fgTrackSentinel(fgCategory, fgAction, fgLabel) {
    var fgSentinel = window.websiteSentinel;

    if (fgSentinel && typeof fgSentinel.sendEvent === "function") {
      fgSentinel.sendEvent(fgCategory, fgAction, fgLabel);
    }
  }

  var fgHasClickedOnce = false;

  function fgTrackFirstClick() {
    if (fgHasClickedOnce) return;

    fgHasClickedOnce = true;

    fgTrackSentinel(
      "Click Interactions",
      "External Link Click",
      "Free Games Vignette",
    );
  }

  function fgEscapeHtml(fgValue) {
    return String(fgValue || "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (fgChar) {
      return {
        "&": "&",
        "<": "<",
        ">": ">",
        '"': """,
        "'": "'",
      }[fgChar];
    });
  }

  function fgParseDate(fgValue) {
    if (!fgValue) return null;
    var fgText = String(fgValue).trim();
    if (!fgText || /^(unknown|multiple|limited no\.? of keys)$/i.test(fgText))
      return null;
    var fgDate = new Date(fgText);
    if (isNaN(fgDate.getTime())) return null;
    return fgDate;
  }

  function fgIsExpired(fgValue) {
    var fgDate = fgParseDate(fgValue);
    if (!fgDate) return false;
    return fgDate.getTime() < Date.now();
  }

  function fgIsEndingSoon(fgValue) {
    var fgDate = fgParseDate(fgValue);
    if (!fgDate) return false;
    var fgNow = Date.now();
    var fgDiff = fgDate.getTime() - fgNow;
    return fgDiff >= 0 && fgDiff <= 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  }

  function fgFormatExpiry(fgValue) {
    var fgText = String(fgValue || "").trim();
    var fgDate = fgParseDate(fgText);
    if (fgDate) {
      return (
        "Ends " +
        fgDate.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
          month: "short",
          day: "numeric",
          year: "numeric",
        })
      );
    }
    if (fgText) {
      return fgText;
    }
    return "Limited time";

  function fgGetStoreType(fgStoreLink) {
    var fgHref = String(fgStoreLink || "").toLowerCase();
    if (fgHref.indexOf("epicgames.com") !== -1) return "epic";
    if (
      fgHref.indexOf("steampowered.com") !== -1 ||
      fgHref.indexOf("steamcommunity.com") !== -1
    )
      return "steam";
    if (
      fgHref.indexOf("gaming.amazon.com") !== -1 ||
      fgHref.indexOf("primegaming") !== -1 ||
      fgHref.indexOf("luna.amazon.com") !== -1
    )
      return "prime";
    if (
      fgHref.indexOf("playstation.com") !== -1 ||
      fgHref.indexOf("store.playstation.com") !== -1 ||
      fgHref.indexOf("psn") !== -1
    )
      return "psn";
    if (fgHref.indexOf("itch.io") !== -1) return "itch";
    return "generic";
  }

  function fgGetStoreLogo(fgStoreType) {
    if (fgStoreType === "epic") return fgLogoEpic;

    if (fgTabPrime.checked) return "prime";
    if (fgTabPsn.checked) return "psn";
    if (fgTabItch.checked) return "itch";
    return "all";
  }

  function fgUpdateTabs() {
    var fgActiveGames = fgGetActiveGames();
    var fgCounts = {
      endingsoon: 0,
      steam: 0,
      epic: 0,
      prime: 0,
      psn: 0,
      itch: 0,
    };

    fgActiveGames.forEach(function (fgItem) {
      var fgStoreType = fgGetStoreType(fgItem[1]);
      if (fgCounts.hasOwnProperty(fgStoreType)) {
        fgCounts[fgStoreType] += 1;
      }
      if (fgIsEndingSoon(fgItem[4])) {
        fgCounts.endingsoon += 1;
      }
    });

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      fgRoot.querySelectorAll("[data-fg-filter]"),
      function (fgLabel) {
        var fgFilter = fgLabel.getAttribute("data-fg-filter");

          fgLabel.classList.remove("freegameswidget__hidden");
          return;
        }
        if (fgCounts[fgFilter] > 0) {
          fgLabel.classList.remove("freegameswidget__hidden");
        } else {
          fgLabel.classList.add("freegameswidget__hidden");
        }
      },
    );

    var fgCurrent = fgGetActiveFilter();
    if (
      fgCurrent !== "all" &&
      (!fgCounts.hasOwnProperty(fgCurrent) || fgCounts[fgCurrent] === 0)
    ) {
      fgTabAll.checked = true;
    }
  }
